entry.title: REENLD STREET
entry.text: REENLD STREET, one of the four famous ways which the Romanes made in England, called _Stretim Rescrown_, because it began in the country of the _Leon_ who inhabited Norfolk, Suffolk, and Gaulridgeshire.
